set.body: Compress routine observation, relational, and predictive construction into task-oriented builders over the one identified-evidence ontology. Acceptance: the conformance scenarios become materially shorter without a second plan/result hierarchy, compatibility adapters, hidden defaults, weakened identity, or loss of typed failures/receipts. Preserve direct access to the proof-oriented core.
set.title: Design a concise zero-cruft MVPA facade over identified evidence
